title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentPreview
description: What an update with the candidate overrides would do, computed without writing anything. The sleeve plan is the one the update would send to accounts if nothing changes in between.

revision.description: The assignment revision the preview was computed against

assigned_version_id.description: The published template version the overrides resolve against

materialized_config.description: The resolved effective tree the update would store

flattened_groups.description: The resolved tree flattened for display, as on the assignment

sleeve_plan.description: What the update would do with each funded slot, in flattened_groups order

transitioning_sleeve_ids.description: Every sleeve the update would leave marked transitioning (winding down at zero target). A set, as on the update response.

AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashClear.description: The tree has no cash node, so the update would remove the account's buffer cash
AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashClear.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashClear

AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashPlan.description: What the update would do to the account's buffer cash: set it to the tree's cash node, or clear it when the tree has no cash node. A 0% buffer is a set, not a clear.

AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashSet.description: The update would set the account's buffer cash to the tree's cash node

absolute_target.description: The buffer's target share of the account's managed value as a percent decimal string (never a number)

AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashSet.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentCashSet

AllocationTemplateAssignmentGroup.description: One non-cash node of the materialized tree, flattened for display: relative weights pre-multiplied into an absolute target, in DFS document order (parent before children = display order). Cash nodes are omitted but their weights still shape siblings' absolute targets. A root that directly carries a strategy menu appears as a depth-0 group (empty path, null parent_name and relative_weight).

node_id.description: The node's stable id ('aatn_' ULID), never empty

path.description: Node ids from the root down to and including this node, exclusive of the root, so its length is the node's depth

parent_name.description: The parent node's name; null when the parent is the root

absolute_target.description: The node's share of the account's managed value as a percent decimal string (never a number)

relative_weight.description: The node's share of its parent as a percent decimal string (never a number)

slots.description: The expected sleeves under this node: one entry per funded strategy. (node_id, strategy_id) pairs are unique across groups.

AllocationTemplateAssignmentGroup.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentGroup

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedAdopt.description: An existing unstamped sleeve holding the slot's strategy would be stamped for the slot in place

absolute_target.description: The sleeve's target share of the account's managed value as a percent decimal string (never a number)

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedAdopt.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedAdopt

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedCreat.description: No sleeve holds the slot yet, so accounts would create one; its id arrives in the update's sleeve_results

absolute_target.description: The sleeve's target share of the account's managed value as a percent decimal string (never a number)

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedCreat.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedCreate

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedSleev.description: What the update would do with one funded slot, keyed by (node_id, strategy_id). Only update and adopt land on an existing sleeve, so only they carry a sleeve_id.

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedUpdat.description: The sleeve already stamped for the slot would be updated in place

absolute_target.description: The sleeve's target share of the account's managed value as a percent decimal string (never a number)

AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedUpdat.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentPlannedUpdate

AllocationTemplateAssignmentSlot.description: One expected sleeve under a group's node, keyed on the account by (node_id, strategy_id)
AllocationTemplateAssignmentSlot.title: AllocationTemplateAssignmentSlot

AllocationTemplateConfig.description: A fully materialized template tree. The document root is itself a node.
AllocationTemplateConfig.title: AllocationTemplateConfig

AllocationTemplateNode.description: A node in the template tree. It holds either child nodes or a strategy menu, never both; cash holds neither. A model_category is a section defined by strategy tags — those tags filter which strategies show up in menus under it, and at least one is required. Ordinary sections and cash must not carry tags.

id.description: Stable node id ('aatn_' ULID). Minted server-side for new nodes: omit or send empty on creation, keep it verbatim on later publishes - child overrides are keyed by it.

name.description: Display name; the root node may have an empty name

kind.description: What this node is. A node is a free-text section; a model_category is a section defined by strategy tags; cash is the funding buffer.

relative_weight.description: The node's share of its parent as a decimal string (never a number). Null means unset; the root carries an implicit 100% and keeps this null.

min_weight.description: Optional lower range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

max_weight.description: Optional upper range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

tag_ids.description: Strategy tag ids from the tags service. Required on a model_category (at least one). Must be omitted or empty on ordinary sections and cash. A nested model_category cannot reuse a tag already set by an ancestor.

children.description: Child nodes; mutually exclusive with strategies

strategies.description: The leaf node's strategy menu; mutually exclusive with children

AllocationTemplateNode.title: AllocationTemplateNode

AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry.description: A reference from a leaf node's menu to an existing strategy, with a relative weight. A 0% weight means the strategy is approved for selection but not allocated by default.

strategy_id.description: The ID of the referenced strategy

relative_weight.description: The entry's share of its menu as a decimal string (never a number). Null means unset.

min_weight.description: Optional lower range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

max_weight.description: Optional upper range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry.title: AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry
